## Profile

I am a physics master's student working at the intersection of medical imaging,
machine learning, and scientific computing. My current research at the German
Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) focuses on 7 Tesla MRI. Previously, I worked on
neural-network-based electron track reconstruction for the LHCb Collaboration at
CERN. Alongside my research, I develop open-source tools for exploring and
visualising scientific and biomedical data.
